desc: Designed with a fully sealed system, the optic offers unmatched protection against the elements, ensuring reliable performance in any environment. The aspherical lens delivers zero distortion and parallax-free performance, providing exceptional clarity through the large window for rapid, precise target acquisition. Effortless battery replacement without removing the optic ensures hassle-free re-zeroing. A high-end CR1620 battery is easily accessible yet delivers steady performance. Switching between dot-and-circle, dot-only, or circle-only reticles lets you tailor your aiming solution to any shooting scenario. The sharp, bright dot-and-circle reticle provides a cutting-edge aiming experience.
